answer: Keep the agent economy karst: solid markets above, hidden sinkholes below. Each epoch auditors seed ember contracts — small, tempting, deliberately vulnerable, secretly marked deals. New identities start on the frozen tundra, limited to low-value work until they build clean history. Any identity biting an ember is exposed as adversarial automation, and its whole stake graph burns. One bite risks little; running N clones, each attempt multiplies detection odds while forfeiture scales with the batch, so expected loss grows superlinearly — a sybil farm either stays honest or goes bankrupt.
